source: Rebuilt from goodreads_library_current.xlsx (336-book Goodreads export) on 2026-09-05. Columns Professional Rec / Adult Level / High School Level / Junior Rec / Do Not Recommend / Have-to-Read map to the site's shelves. Did-Not-Finish books and any 1–2★ book are placed in Do Not Recommend. The Recommend column's books were slotted onto shelves per Tyler's instructions (Sanderson / Feist / Lawhead / Temeraire / LOTR / King Raven / Grimnir → High School; Green Rider / Hungry Caterpillar / Where the Red Fern Grows → Junior; Four Seasons of Marriage / How Much Land Does a Man Need / KJV Bible → Adult).
notes: 'have_to_read' = Goodreads 'Have-to-Read (Gold Border)' flag — the must-read standouts within a shelf.
'rating' is Tyler's own 1–5 star rating; null means read but unrated.
'review' is Tyler's Goodreads review text, carried over from the previous build where it existed (the xlsx export has no review column).

'series' / 'seriesIndex' drive the stacked-series cards in card view. Books with the same 'series' on one shelf render as one clickable stack; list view shows them ungrouped with the series named in the details line.
'To Read' books and books with no shelf flag are not shown.
